name: salon-saas
description: Dart Smart Salon - multi-tenant salon management platform

scripts.dev: node init && concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:website" "npm run dev:salon-websites"
scripts.dev:frontend: node init && npm run dev --prefix frontend
scripts.dev:backend: node init && npm run start:dev --prefix backend
scripts.dev:website: node init && npm run dev --prefix website
scripts.dev:salon-websites: node init && npm run dev --prefix salon-websites
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix website && npm install --prefix salon-websites
scripts.build: node init && npm run build --prefix website && npm run build --prefix salon-websites && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix website && npm run lint --prefix salon-websites && npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix backend
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix frontend && npm run format --prefix backend
